book.name: Zenasis - Stat blo ebriting
book.title: Buk blo Zenasis stori baut stat blo ebriting

content: Zekop i sane gipt go po Iso
Wandei, wen Zekop bin lego gobaigen po Kanan, ol einzel blo God i bin kam po mite em.
Wen Zekop bin luk dem einzel, em bin spik, ‘Diswan wea God i kempaut!’ Zekop bin kole dat ples Maganaim, wea Ibrulangus i min ‘ples blo kemp’.
Zekop i bin sane ol man po teke mesiz go pas po bala blo em Iso, wea da lan blo Ser, lo dat kantri blo Edom.

Zekop i bin prapa spik po dem mesizman, ‘Diswan i wanem yupla mas spik po Iso, bos blo mi, “Sebant blo yu Zekop i spik diskain, ‘Ai bin stap longtaim lo awa Laban ane ai bin stap de antil distaim nau.
Ai gad buluk, kau, dongki, sip, gout ane ol man ane oman sebant. Diskaintaim ai sane dis mesiz po yu gar, bos blo mi, solong yu gobi nadakain api wen yu go luk mi.’” ’
Wen dem mesizman i bin kambaigen po Zekop, dempla spik, ‘Mipla bin go po bala blo yu, Iso, ane em ya kam diskaintaim po mite yu, ane em gad 400 amiman wea em.’

Wen Zekop bin lisen dis niuz, em bin wantaim prapa prait ane mina wori. Den em bin splitemap ol dem ebriting em bin gad po meke tu big mob. Ap blo dem pamle go diswei go po wansaid, den nada ap go nadasaid, den dem sip, gout, ol dem buluk, kau ane ol dem kamal go wansaid ane dem nadawan go nadasaid.
Em bin tingk po emselp diskain, ‘Ip Iso go kam po wanmob ane kile ebriwan, den da nadamob ken ranwei.’
Den Zekop i bin prea, ‘God blo ate blo mi Eibram ane God blo papa blo mi Aizak. AntapGod, yu bin spik po mi, “Gobaigen po kantri blo yu ane po ol kazenbala blo yu, ane ai go meke ebriting orait.”

Ai prapa nugudman bat yu bin soe mi lab blo yu, ane gudpasin blo yu po mi, sebant blo yu. Ai bin krose dis Zodan Riba mata wea wan wokingstik, ane nau ai bin kambaigen wea wan big pamle ane plenti animal ane dempla nap po meke tu big kemp.
Lugaut mi prom bala blo mi Iso, bikoz ai prapa prait prom em. Em mait kam ane kile mipla ebriwan, dem oman ane ol dem pikinini blo mi tu.
Bat yu bin spik wea promis de pas diskain, “Ai go prapa meke gudpasin po yu, ane meke pamlelain blo yu wase san lo sanbis, wea man i kan kauntem bikoz ol prapa plenti.” ’
Wa. Zekop i bin slip de po wan nait bat neksdei, prom ebridem animal wea em bin gad, em bin suzem po gibe present po bala blo em Iso,
200 omangout ane 20 mangout, 200 omansip ane 20 mansip,
30 omankamal ane beibi blo dempla, 40 kau ane 10 buluk, 20 omandongki ane 10 mandongki.

Zekop bin splitemap dem animal go po ol dipren mob lo dempla ane em bin meke ol sebant blo em po lugaut dem animal. Zekop spik po dem sebant blo em diskain, ‘Yupla wagbaut prant lo mi, ane meke big speis bituin dem mob blo dem dipren animal.’
Zekop i bin oda dem sebant uda go wagbaut rait prant diskain, ‘Wen Iso i mite yu, ane em aske yu, “Uda bos blo yu? Wea yupla go? Uda bos blo dem animal?”
Den yu go ansa gobaigen po em, “Dem animal ya i blo sebant blo yu Zekop. Dem animal ya i present po yu, Iso, bos blo em. Zekop ya kam biain lo mipla.” ’

Zekop bin spik da seim oda po dem sebant blo dem sekan lot animal, ane po dem namba tri lot sebant ane po ebridem nadawan uda bin pole wea dem animal biain. Em bin spik diskain, ‘Diswan i wanem yu mas spik po Iso wen yu luk em,

ane prapa spik diskain, “Sebant blo yu, Zekop, ya kam biain lo mipla.” ’ Zekop bin tingk diskain po emselp, ‘Diswan mait go elpe em po nomo wail po mi wea dem present wea ai bin sanem po em pas. Wen ai go luk em, mait em go meke mi bala blo em gen.’
Wa, dem present blo dem animal prom Zekop i bin go pas, ane Zekop i bin gobaigen po da tent blo em po stap emselp po da nait lo dat ples.
Zekop i pait wea God
Lo dat seim nait, Zekop i bin meke redi ane em bin sane Lia ane Reisel ane dem nada tu oman blo em ane leben pikinini blo em, ane dempla i bin krose da salo pat blo da Zabok Riba.
Seimkain, em bin sane ebrisamting wea i bin blo em go wea dempla tu.

Zekop no bin krosem go nadasaid lo da riba bat em bin stap emselp, ane wan man i bin kam po em ane bin stat po puse Zekop godaun po da graun. Dis pait melen da man ane Zekop i bin go raittru po deilait.
Wen da man i bin luk em i kan win po puse Zekop godaun po da graun, em bin ite Zekop lo ipbon, ane da ipbon blo em i bin kamaut prom zoint. Bat Zekop i bin stil trai po puse da man godaun po graun.
Den da man i bin spik, ‘Ei! Laue mi po go, i stat po deilait nau.’ Bat Zekop ansa po em, ‘Nono! Ai nogo laue yu po go antil yu go blese mi.’
Da man i bin aske Zekop, ‘Wanem neim blo yu?’ Em ansa, ‘Mi Zekop.’

Den da man i tok gen, ‘I go nomo go kole yu Zekop, bat nau i go kole yu Izrael, bikoz yu bin pait wea God ane lo dem pipol, ane yu bin win.’ Wea Ibrulangus, Izrael i min ‘pait gense God o God i pait’.
Den Zekop i bin aske da man, ‘Spik mi neim blo yu.’ Bat da man i bin ansabaik, ‘Aukam yu wande sabe neim blo mi?’ Ane da man i bin blese Zekop.
Zekop i bin kole da ples Peniel. Wea Ibrulangus i min ‘pes blo God’. Em bin spik diskain, ‘Ai bin luk God prapa klostuwan, ane ai stil laipwan. God no bin kile mi.’
Da san bin kam antap nau wen Zekop libe Peniel ane em bin wagbaut kripolwan bikoz prom ipbon blo em.
Ane daswai tidei dem pamlelain blo Izrael no kaikai da mit blo animal prom da ipbon, bikoz i bin lo dis pat blo mit wea dat man i bin ite Zekop wea da ipbon.
